Island_074.settlement_role: Remote northern stronghold and expedition base
Island_074.notes: Regional anchor for The Great Cold North. Preserve a large sense of wilderness; production should remain secondary to exploration and spectacle.

Island_073.settlement_role: Northern market town and forestry frontier
Island_073.notes: Regional anchor for Frost Marches. Snowy frontier character; support timber and ice trade without replacing the dedicated Wood & Tree ecosystem.

Island_106.primary_function: Ice routes / shipwreck salvage / coastal outposts
Island_106.notes: Regional anchor for Shattered Ice Coast. Emphasize dangerous seas, icebergs, wrecks, and remote navigation.

Island_081.notes: Regional anchor for The Crownlands. Central power, major settlements, and the core Village/Iron/Raid production ecosystem.

Island_082.settlement_role: High royal city and monastery network
Island_082.notes: Regional anchor for The High Kingdom. Keep the region monumental and vertical; Stone Highlands remains the main bulk quarry/geology producer.

Island_076.notes: Regional anchor for The Hearthlands. Primary home of the Food & Brewing ecosystem, with inns, breweries, kitchens, lakes, and comfortable towns.

Island_084.notes: Regional anchor for The Timberlands. Consolidate all tree and wood families here, including the intentional Nether wood exception.

Island_093.settlement_role: Farm towns, mills, canals, and market villages
Island_093.notes: Regional anchor for The Breadbasket. Primary Agriculture ecosystem, including bone meal/moss support and large-scale crop exports.

Island_088.settlement_role: Main trade city, docks, warehouses, and distribution center
Island_088.notes: Regional anchor for The Grand Exchange. Central import/export hub; do not centralize all processing here—production stays with the resource ecosystems that feed it.

Island_077.settlement_role: Engineer city, workshops, and automation yards
Island_077.notes: Regional anchor for Engineer's Reach. Primary Redstone Engineering ecosystem and technical manufacturing district.

Island_089.notes: Regional anchor for Artisan Coast. Decorative production, color industries, and high-value specialty manufacturing using imports from other regions.

Island_075.settlement_role: Fortified edge settlement and dangerous-resource outpost
Island_075.notes: Regional anchor for The Haunted Marches. Main Overworld Hostile Mob ecosystem; settlements should feel defensive and sparse.

Island_087.settlement_role: Marsh town, boardwalk ports, and wetland industry
Island_087.notes: Regional anchor for The Blackfen. Focus on swamp resources, slime, mangrove character, and submerged ruins without duplicating Red Clay Basin's ceramics role.

Island_086.settlement_role: Mountain quarry towns and stoneworking villages
Island_086.notes: Regional anchor for Stone Highlands. Primary bulk Stone & Geology ecosystem: cliffs, quarries, stoneworks, and mountain settlements.

Island_083.settlement_role: Clay towns, brickworks, and terracotta workshops
Island_083.notes: Regional anchor for Red Clay Basin. Primary Mud, Clay & Ceramics ecosystem with terracotta, brick, and clay-processing identity.

Island_080.notes: Regional anchor for The Sunken Coast. Lagoons, tidal ruins, fishing settlements, and coastal resource support; Guardian production remains centered in Sapphire Coast.

Island_090.notes: Regional anchor for The Crystal Deep. Main Amethyst & Sculk ecosystem with geodes, deep caves, and ancient/deep-dark atmosphere.

Island_047.settlement_role: Volcanic industrial city and forge complex
Island_047.notes: Regional anchor for The Volcano. Major lava and basalt destination with dramatic foundries; keep dedicated Nether mob/resource ecosystems in Ember Coast.

Island_097.settlement_role: Pirate haven, shipyard, and free-trade port
Island_097.notes: Regional anchor for Pirate Island. Maritime character, shipbuilding, hidden coves, and illicit trade; this is a destination first, production support second.

Island_102.secondary_feature: Gold/Piglin; Blaze/Wither; Ghast/Magma/Froglight; Hoglin; Nether vegetation; Nether stoneworks
Island_102.settlement_role: Volcanic industrial ports and portal-linked production towns
Island_102.notes: Regional anchor for The Ember Coast. Cluster the six dedicated Nether production ecosystems here while keeping them as distinct islands/districts rather than collapsing them into one factory.

Island_096.settlement_role: Reef city, ocean ruins, and guardian-production ports
Island_096.notes: Regional anchor for The Sapphire Coast. Primary Ocean & Guardian production ecosystem with coral reefs and monumental marine architecture.

Island_085.settlement_role: Tropical farm towns and creature-rich settlements
Island_085.notes: Regional anchor for The Isles of Plenty. Primary Passive Animal & Creature ecosystem with tropical supporting crops and bee production.

Island_095.settlement_role: Ports, rail interchanges, lighthouses, and transfer stations
Island_095.notes: Regional anchor for The Transit Isles. Main transportation network. The former Convergence islands are folded into this region rather than retained as a 25th region.

Island_128.secondary_feature: Enderman; Shulker & storage; Chorus & Purpur; End obsidian & special systems
Island_128.settlement_role: Exploration enclaves, research outposts, and secretive settlements
Island_128.notes: Regional anchor for The Shrouded Isles. Cluster the four dedicated End production ecosystems here as distinct islands/districts while preserving a mysterious exploration-first identity.
